title: AuditPruneResult
description: Result of `deadlatch audit prune`. CLI JSON stdout must match this document. Counts refer to UTC day shard files, not individual records. Never includes absolute paths, credentials, account data, or raw log lines. Legacy single-file logs are never deleted or migrated. future_segments are kept.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this result document.

status.description: clean = nothing deleted; pruned = at least one out-of-window shard was removed; error = lock/delete/dir-fsync failure.

removed_segments.description: Count of UTC shard files deleted because their date is older than the 30-calendar-day window.

kept_segments.description: Count of in-window UTC shard files left in place (includes today).

future_segments.description: Count of future-dated UTC shard files that were kept and counted.
